info.title: AMOS API
info.description: API for Analytical Methods & Open Spectra (AMOS). JSON operations require Content-Type: application/json; uploads require multipart/form-data with a real file part. Use POST for searches with request bodies. A browser address-bar request uses GET and cannot invoke a POST operation. Path examples illustrate identifier syntax and do not guarantee that a record exists in the selected deployment. Pagination cursors are opaque tokens returned by the server; omit the cursor for the first page. Metadata PUT operations write data and may clear omitted metadata or substance associations: fetch the editor information and submit the intended complete values. File ingestion performs PDF processing/OCR and indexing synchronously; a client timeout does not prove that an upload failed. Check for the created record before retrying. All error responses use application/problem+json with type, title, status, detail, and request_id. Legacy error/ issues fields are retained for client errors. Every response includes X-Request-ID. Server errors omit internal exception details. Failed requests roll back uncommitted database work; an already committed upload cannot be undone by a later processing failure. Do not automatically retry writes after a timeout or connection loss.

post.summary: Generates an Excel workbook which lists all records in the database that contain a given set of DTXSIDs.
post.description:
There are a number of options for either filtering records from the database or incorporating additional information

If a record contains more than one of the searched DTXSIDs, then that record will appear once for each searched substance it contains.

all.description: Legacy UI flag. Set the individual metadata flags explicitly; the server does not expand this flag.

ionization_mode.description: Include whether the spectrum was collected in a positive or negative mode experiment.  Not always available.

num_peaks.description: Include the number of peaks in the spectrum.

rating.description: Include a clean/noisy rating for the spectrum, based on the spectral and normalized entropy scores.

spectral_entropy.description: Include the spectral entropy score for a given spectrum.  Will be missing for spectra with only one peak.

always_download_file.description: Legacy UI field retained for compatibility. The current handler returns a workbook even when no records match.

base_url.description: URL for the AMOS frontend.  Used to construct the internal links in the output file.

include_classyfire.description: Flag for whether to include the top four levels of a ClassyFire classification for each of the searched substances, if it exists.

include_external_links.description: Flag for whether to include database records that are purely external links (e.g., spectra that we can link to but cannot store directly in the database).

include_functional_uses.description: Flag for whether to include functional use classifications based on the ChemFuncT ontology.  Only exists for around 21,000 substances in the database.

include_source_counts.description: Flag for whether to include counts of a substance's appearances in patents, PubMed articles, and other external sources.

methodologies.description: Filters the returned results by analytical methodologies.  This argument should be a dictionary with four keys with boolean values -- "all", "GC/MS", "LC/MS", and "NMR".  There are some methodologies with small numbers of records (e.g., IR spectra) which will only appear in the data if "all" is set to true.

record_types.description: Filters returned results by record type.  This argument should be a dictionary with three keys with boolean values -- "Fact Sheet", "Method", and "Spectrum".  Note that the "Spectrum" flag will return spectra of all types -- mass, NMR, etc.

identifiers.description: List of DTXSIDs or other identifiers to search for.

400.description: Invalid request fields, cursor, or document type. Returns application/problem+json with request_id; legacy error and issues fields are retained when present.

415.description: Request rejected. Use the documented Content-Type. Returns application/problem+json with type, title, status, detail, and request_id; legacy error and issues fields are preserved.

500.description: An unexpected server error occurred. Returns application/problem+json with type, title, status, detail, and request_id. X-Request-ID identifies the corresponding server log entry.

502.description: An upstream HTTP/search service failed or returned an unusable response. Returns application/problem+json with type, title, status, detail, and request_id. X-Request-ID identifies the corresponding server log entry.

503.description: The database connection or transaction is temporarily unavailable or busy. Returns application/problem+json with type, title, status, detail, and request_id. X-Request-ID identifies the corresponding server log entry.

504.description: An upstream service exceeded its connection or read timeout. Returns application/problem+json with type, title, status, detail, and request_id. X-Request-ID identifies the corresponding server log entry.
